note: v1: only type and corners are assigned (rule:assign-type-corners). Ground, colour strategy and headline are chosen by the model inside its mode (rule:mode-limits).

colour_strategies.restrained: tinted ground, colour on actions and states only
colour_strategies.committed: one saturated colour carries 30–60% of the first screen (a rail, header band or hero block); content still sits on --surface
colour_strategies.full: 3–4 named colour roles, each with a job (categories, states, sections)
colour_strategies.drenched: the ground itself is saturated; frame-only: body text, cards, forms and charts sit on --surface

headlines.quiet: barely larger than body; hierarchy from position and space
headlines.condensed: narrow cut or tight tracking (not below -0.04em)
headlines.oversized: fills its column, at most 2 lines; never a whole sentence
